title: Xiaomi MIUI 10.3 (Android 9.1) FS + Miaomiao 1 missed connection
symptom: On a Xiaomi Note 7 with MIUI 10.3 (Android 9.1), a Freestyle sensor via Miaomiao 1 is seen by the phone but does not connect to xDrip+ (06 Oct release). Bluetooth pairing also fails.
fix: mustang011 suggests a procedure: stop sensor in xDrip, charge MM, reset MM with micro button, reboot phone, start sensor, wait for 3 measurements, calibrate. Also recommends updating Xiaomi ROM to latest beta from miuipolska.pl, and updating xDrip to latest alpha from GitHub.
evidence_quote: I have a special procedure for connecting MM to the phone again or to replace the sensor. 1. In Xdrip "--- >> Stop Sensor >> STOP SENSOR" 2. Charges batteries in MM 3. Resets MM with the micro button 3. Rebooot your smartphone with Xdrip 4. In Xdrip "--- >> START SENSOR" 5. Waiting for 3 measurements (15 minutes) with MM or longer when I took a new sensor 6. calibrates Libra readings with blood glucose meter
